title: Adaptively Sparse Transformers
answer_short: The adaptively sparse Transformer improves interpretability by allowing attention heads to specialize more and with higher confidence, due to context-dependent sparsity patterns enabled by replacing softmax with α-entmax.
answer_rationale: The model improves interpretability by introducing adaptive sparsity through α-entmax, which allows attention heads to focus on relevant words with zero weights for irrelevant ones, enhancing specialization and confidence. This is supported by findings that sparse attention helps uncover head specializations and increases interpretability without sacrificing accuracy.
